message:
[Page 1] How Fernwood runs Fernwood Labs is a 14-person software company in Chicago. We build data tools for mid-size healthcare and logistics companies. There are five teams: Leadership (Wade Wilson, founder), Engineering (led by Priya Nair), Growth (led by Dev Kumar), Operations (Krishna) and Finance (Lena Ortiz, part time). Until now we have run on Zoho and a lot of spreadsheets. The export attached has our people, candidates, software vendors, expenses, leave and customer contracts. This write-up says how each part works today; the policies say the rules. Everyone reports to one manager. Managers approve their team's time off. Wade and Krishna look after every customer contract; account managers look after their own. [Page 3] Money: tools, budgets and spend Lena Ortiz owns our tools list: every software seat and vendor, what it costs a year and when it renews. Each team has a budget for the quarter, and Lena tracks what is spent against it. Tool owners are reminded a month before a tool renews. Expenses and purchases go through Spend. People submit their own expenses with a receipt and a category; Lena approves them and marks them paid. Purchases over $2,000 need Krishna's approval. Each person sees their own spend; Lena and Wade see all of it. Time off: people request it, their manager approves or declines, and it is marked taken once the days have passed. Lena keeps everyone's yearly balance. [Page 12] Time off policy Everyone has 25 days of vacation a year, plus sick days as needed. Requests go to the person's manager, who approves or declines them. Nobody approves their own request. Approved time off is marked taken once its last day has passed. [Page 13] Public holidays 2026 Fernwood is closed on these days, which don't count against vacation: New Year's Day (Jan 1), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (Jan 19), Presidents' Day (Feb 16), Memorial Day (May 25), Juneteenth (Jun 19), Independence Day (Jul 3, observed), Labor Day (Sep 7), Thanksgiving (Nov 26), Day after Thanksgiving (Nov 27), Christmas Day (Dec 25). [Page 14] Time off balances Lena keeps each person's yearly balance: allowance and days taken. A request that would go over the balance can't be sent. Tables attached (name, header and row count; the cells are data too): "Employee Email","Leave Type","From","To","Days","Status","Note"
Latest message from Wade Wilson: Set up Time off: Leave requests and yearly balances. People request vacation or sick days and their manager approves or declines. Approved time off is marked taken once its last day has passed. Lena keeps each person's yearly balance of 25 vacation days, and public holidays don't count against it. Its rules, from the policies: - A request goes to the person's manager, who approves or declines it, and nobody approves their own. - Approved time off is marked taken once its last day has passed. - A request that would go over the person's balance can't be sent. - Everyone has 25 vacation days a year, plus sick days as needed. Its rows come from leave.csv, imported into its first sheet. The file's columns fill plain columns of that sheet (text, dates, amounts, people, choices, steps); a link can't be filled from a file, so a link column there stays empty for imported rows.
